thread:
noah: Support flagged a few users after yesterday's SDK patch - parameter `temperature` was clamped silently in v2 client. Docs still show old behavior. We need a small corrections PR + short deprecation note about the clamping behavior.

talia: Thanks. Do we have repro steps?

noah: Yes - call with temperature 2.0 and you get 1.0 in v2. It was intentional but not documented. Also some examples pass floats >1 in tutorials.

oscar: I'll open PR to fix examples and add a compatibility note recommending `temperature: Math.min(temp, 1.0)` for now. We should also add a note in the migration guide: "v2 enforces [0.0,1.0] for temperature and will normalize inputs."

noah: Good. Let's also add a quick FAQ entry and a tiny code snippet showing how to detect silent clamping from the response metadata when available.

docs-bot: Please add `docs-update` label and include changelog line.

oscar: PR #4933 created. Text fixes + migration guide paragraph + FAQ. pinging @talia for review.

talia: Reviewing now. Quick nit: update the JS quickstart to use `temperature: 0.8` rather than 2.0.

oscar: Updated. Merged #4933.

noah: Thanks all. I'll coordinate a short internal note to support so they can advise customers.
